author: Nelev
body:
Colours and layout only. No behaviour changed — the store, the submit handler and the API client are untouched.

## Palette

A teal primary rather than the blue every health product defaults to, and not a red that reads as alarm. Neutrals carry a trace of blue (hue 230) instead of being flat grey, so the screen reads calm rather than cold and the teal does not look accidental.

Dark mode is deep slate-teal, never pure black — pure black on an OLED screen makes text edges vibrate — with the teal lifted and desaturated, because the light-mode value turns muddy on dark.

The light tokens are complete but currently unused: `layout.tsx` pins the `dark` class, so removing or toggling it is all that stands between here and a working light theme.

## Layout

- The conversation sits in a bordered panel on a soft radial backdrop above `sm`, and goes full-bleed below it, where a floating card would only waste vertical space.
- The header gains a mark and a chip naming the patient whose record is open — a clinical tool that does not say whose chart it is reading is one wrong answer away from a real problem.
- Bubbles square off the corner facing their own avatar, so the two sides read apart at a glance.
- The message column is narrower than the shell, keeping the measure readable and letting each side sit against its own edge.
- The composer is styled as a single card with the input borderless inside it, so the focus ring surrounds the whole row, over a standing note that Medas is not a doctor.

## Verified

`tsc`, `yarn lint` and `yarn build` all pass. Rendered from the production build at desktop and phone widths, in both themes: no horizontal scroll at 375px, and the patient chip drops out there as intended.
